title: 52 Week Three Week Five Lot DC 2006 Weekly Series J.G. Jones Cover Hawkgirl
conditionDescription: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Lot of 2: 52 Week Three (May 24, 2006) and Week Five (June 7, 2006), DC Comics weekly series. J.G. Jones covers. Week Three: "Lex Luthor: The Fall and Rise of an American Icon"; Week Five: Hawkgirl and the return of the space heroes. Both with The History of the DC Universe backups (Dan Jurgens). Direct sales, $2.50 cover price each.

Back covers: Week Three Lara Croft Tomb Raider: Legend ad; Week Five Superman Returns: The Videogame ad.

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
